attributes.name: tensionModulus
attributes.description: Tension elasticity modulus

attributes.name: compressionModulus
attributes.description: Compresion elasticity modulus

attributes.name: shearModulus
attributes.description: shear elasticity modulus

attributes.name: alphaKr
attributes.description: Dimensionless coefficient used for the rolling stiffness.

attributes.name: alphaKtw
attributes.description: Dimensionless coefficient used for the twist stiffness.

attributes.name: nuBending
attributes.description: Bending elastic stress limit

attributes.name: nuTwist
attributes.description: Twist elastic stress limit

attributes.name: sigmaTension
attributes.description: Tension elastic stress limit

attributes.name: sigmaCompression
attributes.description: Compression elastic stress limit

attributes.name: shearCohesion
attributes.description: Shear elastic stress limit

attributes.name: creepTension
attributes.description: Tension/compression creeping coefficient. Usual values between 0 and 1.

attributes.name: creepBending
attributes.description: Bending creeping coefficient. Usual values between 0 and 1.

attributes.name: creepTwist
attributes.description: Twist creeping coefficient. Usual values between 0 and 1.

attributes.name: unloadTension
attributes.description: Tension/compression plastic unload coefficient. Usual values between 0 and +infinity.

attributes.name: unloadBending
attributes.description: Bending plastic unload coefficient. Usual values between 0 and +infinity.

attributes.name: unloadTwist
attributes.description: Twist plastic unload coefficient. Usual values between 0 and +infinity.

attributes.name: epsilonMaxTension
attributes.description: Maximal plastic strain tension

attributes.name: epsilonMaxCompression
attributes.description: Maximal plastic strain compression

attributes.name: etaMaxBending
attributes.description: Maximal plastic bending strain

attributes.name: etaMaxTwist
attributes.description: Maximal plastic twist strain

attributes.name: frictionAngle
attributes.description: Contact friction angle (in radians). Hint : use 'radians(degreesValue)' in python scripts.

attributes.name: young
attributes.description: elastic modulus [Pa]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: poisson
attributes.description: Poisson's ratio or the ratio between shear and normal stiffness [-]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Numeric id of this material; is non-negative only if this Material is shared (i.e. in O.materials), -1 otherwise. This value is set automatically when the material is inserted to the simulation via O.materials.append. (This id was necessary since before boost::serialization was used, shared pointers were not tracked properly; it might disappear in the future)

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual identifier for this material; can be used for shared materials lookup in MaterialContainer.

attributes.name: density
attributes.description: Density of the material [kg/m³]

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: newAssocState
methods.description: Return new State instance, which is associated with this Material. Some materials have special requirement on state type and calling this function when the body is created will ensure that they match. (This is done automatically if you use utils.sphere, … functions from python).

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
